title: Malicious code in vas-tops2-core-property-search (npm)
description: The npm package vas-tops2-core-property-search contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by this package.
